title: Constraint
description: A first-class bottleneck entity (e.g. CoWoS capacity). Nodes and edges reference constraints by id; selecting one in the UI highlights everything downstream.

category.description: capacity = manufacturing throughput limits; regulatory = export controls etc.; resource = water/power/materials; geographic = concentration risk

description.description: One-paragraph plain-language explanation of the bottleneck and why it matters

metrics.description: Time-stamped quantitative estimates of the constraint (e.g. CoWoS wafers/month over time). Multiple entries with different as_of dates build the historical record.

severity.description: Current judgment of how binding this constraint is; revisit as data changes
